name: opensees_example_effective_stress_column
disabled_reason: Both engines complete the run. Displacements and stresses diverge during plastic gravity. A material-point replay matches the recorded OpenSees stresses, but rounding at zero strain increment selects different tangents at some integration points.
reference: Effective Stress Site Response Analysis of a Layered Soil Column, Christopher McGann and Pedro Arduino, University of Washington.
notes: The published effective-stress archive omits velocityHistory.out. This case uses the 7,990-sample, 0.005-second Gilroy velocity history from the companion total-stress example.
